title: Test-Time Compute: How AI Learned to Think Before It Speaks (Inside OpenAI o1, DeepSeek-R1 & PRMs)

visual.metaphor: Robotic auctioneer podium vs cognitive puzzle board, 3D pre-training vs test-time scaling coordinate space, transparent internal thought scratchpad with branching deduction trees, dual robotic assembly line inspectors (ORM vs PRM), DeepSeek-R1 pure RL labyrinth with spontaneous 'Aha!' moment, and cosmic Monte Carlo Tree Search constellation

beats.description: Cognitive psychology laboratory; fast robotic auctioneer spits instant wrong answers to the bat-and-ball riddle; Kahneman System 1 vs System 2 split
Manim 3D coordinate space; Chinchilla pre-training scaling curve plateaus while test-time compute curve shoots vertically; small 8B model out-reasoning 70B model
Transparent LLM chamber; glowing cyan token blocks construct a dynamic working memory with hypotheses, verification checks, and backtracking
Mathematical assembly line; Outcome Reward Model (ORM) checks only final digit while Process Reward Model (PRM) scans each deduction step with surgical laser verification
Dark digital labyrinth; DeepSeek-R1-Zero with pure GRPO reinforcement learning spontaneously discovers self-reflection, pauses to rethink, and reaches the eureka summit
Breathtaking cosmic Monte Carlo Tree of Thoughts; AlphaZero meets language models; pruning dead ends and expanding truth paths into super-human scientific discovery
